subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Autonomous Drones: Flight Without Pilots
description: A short lesson to help you apply Autonomous Drones: Flight Without Pilots.

hook.text: The MQ-9 Reaper drone can stay airborne for 27 hours. Its pilot sits in an air-conditioned trailer thousands of miles away.

buildup.text: Without a pilot aboard, drones eliminate cockpit weight. They can pull maneuvers that would black out a human pilot.

discovery.text: Autonomous flight uses GPS, inertial navigation, and sensor fusion. The drone builds a real-time model of its environment.

twist.text: Urban air mobility envisions electric drone taxis. Joby and Lilium build vertical-takeoff aircraft powered by batteries.

climax.text: Regulation — not technology — is the biggest barrier. Airspace rules weren't built for millions of small autonomous aircraft.

punchline.text: The pilot left the cockpit. Next, the pilot leaves the loop entirely.

quiz.question: What is the biggest barrier to widespread autonomous drone flight?
options: Battery technology cannot support flights longer than 30 minutes
Regulatory and airspace rules weren't designed for millions of small autonomous aircraft
Autonomous navigation systems cannot handle weather conditions like rain or wind
